reviews.title: Glitchy App, Great Service
reviews.text: Jotform is such an excellent service and deserves 5 stars. This review is specifically for the app which is glitchy to create substantial edits with. The desktop is way better. Hoping they update the app because having easy mobile access is great.

reviews.title: So so so Glitchy
reviews.text: I straight up do not believe for a second the vast majority of the reviews for this app are real. This is by far the glitchiest app I have ever used. It barely functions and it has only gone further down hill. There is no way enough people approve of this dumpster fire of an app for it to legitimately be rated 4.9 stars.

reviews.title: System ai suspends for no reason
reviews.text: I downloaded the app today to use a new business. I just started as I’m making my forms, I randomly get suspended with no warning or anything. All I was making was a Client intake form and then also showing. A form for the types of packages. Was only on the app for two hours and got suspended.

reviews.title: Impossible to contact customer service
reviews.text: Their CS is ran by ai. I have tried to contact them numerous times. When trying to submit a form-it says I have to enter my email first, which I did but it still won’t submit. Can I please have a direct contact email please? This is a paid account and presently I can’t even use it.

reviews.title: Cannot login
reviews.text: Always had teething issues with Jotform but now I’m unable to login whatsoever. It signs in, says syncing data then logs straight out by itself. Been with Jotform for a few years for my business but I think it’s time for another platform.

reviews.title: Frustrating User Experience
reviews.text:
I really want to like this app because it is a useful tool, and when we first started using it, it worked well. Unfortunately, over time the experience has gotten progressively worse.

My biggest frustration is the forced automatic logout every two hours. This happens on both desktop and mobile devices. Having to repeatedly log back in on every device we use makes the app unnecessarily frustrating and inefficient. There is no good reason a user should have to constantly reauthenticate during normal use.

Customer service is another major problem. You cannot talk to an actual person, and you rarely, if ever, deal with the same person twice. You submit an issue through the app and then receive repeated assurances that the issue is being investigated or that the developers have been contacted, but the problems often never get resolved.

I have a support request that has been ongoing for two years. After months of repeatedly following up because nobody proactively followed up with me, I eventually stopped trying. Two years later, the issue still has not been fixed.

The app is also slow and buggy, particularly when editing forms. Tasks that should be quick and simple can become unnecessarily slow and frustrating.

It is disappointing because this could be a very good and useful product. Unfortunately, the combination of forced logouts, poor customer service, unresolved issues, slow performance, and bugs has made the overall experience increasingly frustrating. I wish I could give

reviews.title: It Was Great…What Changed?
reviews.text: This app WAS awesome and made workflows that required “approvals” from multiple people convenient and fast. I don’t know what happened but all of a sudden there’s no way to approve or write comments on workflows through the app. That basically makes the app completely useless. Even just trying to view workflow and form submissions is clunky. The app constantly crashes forcing me to restart it to continue to search for the form submissions. Fix this!

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: They charged me 300.00 when they promote monthly payments. Never will use this app again.

reviews.title: Not great
reviews.text: Very annoying. Not user friendly. Blocked my account bc I needed to build a form that required my clients ID. But they have no issues using ai to track what you do.

reviews.title: Automated Suspension!
reviews.text: I worked hours on a form and I just got suspended with no warning at all while I was working on the form! The fact that an automated system can just arbitrarily suspend me is scary. This is not a good model if you are counting on these for business.

reviews.title: Worst Customer Service Period
reviews.text: You can't talk to someone directly, they will email you back. what's even worse...you can't talk to the same person, so when the first person asks you a question or tries to help then asks you to do something a new person will come in to the conversation and you will have to start over since they don't read the whole conversation. a problem that could take 5 minutes talking to a real person takes days with waiting for responses, bad solutions, and then multiple people stepping in during the process. they know this is a horrible process and that their customers hate it yet don't do anything about it. don't use this app!!

reviews.title: Errors when submitting
reviews.text:
Our teams use this app to audit work from contractors. It’s extremely frustrating taking 15-20 pictures to then submit and have the system crash and not save the work.

I continue using it because this is what the company uses, but it was up to me. I would have discarded this app a long time ago.

reviews.title: Outdated, clunky, overpriced, generic looking.
reviews.text: Outdated tech! AI has rendered this entire business model obsolete. Any ai agent can build better looking, more functional, easier to use form for a fraction of the price and a fraction of a cost. Their business model is to lure you into paying for premium options and hoping you forget to cancel your subscription. Buyer beware!

reviews.title: APP IS HORRIBLE
reviews.text: my business partner and I have been using your forms and the app for several years, and ever since it updated a few weeks ago it has been complete garbage. We have to constantly log out close all windows and then log back in and refresh to see new form submissions. It runs extremely slow now also. It’s getting to the point where if something isn’t fixed, we will sadly be looking for another service to switch to. We both have the app and it’s not even showing us the same information at the same time. Terrible.

reviews.title: SCAM/OVERCHARGING
reviews.text: They doubled charged me for 7 months totaling in 1000$ in overcharges and they refuse to refund, or give credits. Find an app that won’t scam you

reviews.title: Removing features to charge you more
reviews.text: One key feature we relied on was the Shared With Me view. You’ve removed that and replaced it with your team workspaces which requires a massive upgrade in fees. Shameful. You’ve made the app useless

reviews.title: All or nothing options available
reviews.text: I was using the app for bookings for my exercise classes, the free starter plan worked well for up to 100 entries a month, which I used for nearly a year but I required more so I needed an upgrade. I was willing to pay but the jump from free to a bronze plan is so large and expensive it wasn’t worth it. I’ve moved over to Google Docs for free with zero issues.

reviews.title: Rough
reviews.text: I’ve had a lot of instances that the app just simply won’t open. Seems to happen right after I get a submission I have to open and exit it multiple times to get it to open and even then I’ve had to wait over a day before it will allow me to open it again.

reviews.title: Wouldn’t let me sign up
reviews.text: This app sucks! Wouldn’t let me make or log in to any sort of account. I don’t recommend using this app!
